name: Foskeia
sum: One of the smallest ornithopods, a rhabdodontomorph from the Early Cretaceous of Spain known from multiple individuals of different ages.
wsnote: Among the smallest ornithopods; no length in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; formally named in 2026 from fossils of the Castrillo de la Reina Formation, formerly called the Vegagete ornithopod.
material: Multiple individuals of different ontogenetic stages; the largest is a late subadult by bone histology.
biology: Limb-bone histology shows the species was among the smallest ornithopods.
author: Dieudonné et al. 2026
